notes.title: Hotfix 5/18
notes.notes:
This patch fixes

Some issues when pushing boxes onto the player
Some issues when pushing boxes onto multiple players at once
Some issues when pushing boxes onto the player while another player dies at the same time

If you have more issues, please email realmanduckproductions@gmail.com
